name: code_parallel_merge_candidate
description: Deterministic code_parallel decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

merge.description: Merge task output. Only merge.merge.commit and merge.mergeState are inspected; a missing/non-mapping value is treated as empty.

fallbackCommit.description: Commit to report when merge.merge.commit is missing or blank, typically the pre-merge HEAD.

commit.description: Resolved commit: merge.merge.commit when it is a non-blank string, else fallbackCommit.

mergeState.description: Passed through from merge.mergeState; defaults to 'merge_blocked' when missing or not a string.
